caption: The drawing consists of a repeating pattern featuring stylized botanical elements and abstract shapes. The background is a tan or light beige color, filled with closely spaced short horizontal green lines, creating a textured appearance. Over this background, there are large wavy, vertical bands or vines filled with solid green color, each adorned with multiple arching, darker green leaf-like shapes protruding from both sides. Scattered among the bands on the background are rounded, bulbous forms, resembling plant buds or seed pods, colored in a similar green hue with dark green tips and markings. The overall composition uses a limited palette primarily of greens and beige, with repeating curved and rounded shapes arranged to create a sense of pattern across the drawing. The drawing is bordered by a wide, off-white margin, and a name is written in the bottom left corner.
title: Wall Paper
